headline: Man About The HOUSE 🏠 Star Richard O'SULLIVAN 🍆 Dies Aged 82 😢
text:
OH NO 😱 the legendary 🍆 MAN ABOUT THE HOUSE 🏠 star Richard O'SULLIVAN has finally CROSSED 🪦 that final curtain 🎭 at the tender age of 82 after living his last 23 YEARS 🕰️ surrounded by close FAMILY 👨‍👩‍👧 at Brinsworth House 🏡 the Royal Variety Charity's care HOME 🛏️ in west London where the absolute LEGEND 🕴️ had been chilling 🍹 for more than two DECADES 🌟!! Giles Cooper from the charity DROPPED 💧 this heartfelt statement calling him a MASTER 🎩 of effortless CHARM 😘 and impeccable comic TIMING ⏱️ who brought pure WARMTH 🔥 wit and unforgettable JOY 😂 to millions of living rooms as a true GIANT 🗼 of British television!! The man was basically the original DILF sitcom DADDY 🧔 who had us all down BAD 😩 for his cheeky grin and that Robin Tripp SWAGGER 🚶‍♂️ back in the 70s when sharing a flat with two single LADIES 👭 was straight up DARING 🔥!!

His son JAMES O'SULLIVAN came through with the most touching TRIBUTE 🕯️ saying his dad was just as FUNNY 🤣 and charming in real LIFE 💖 as he appeared on our TV screens over the YEARS 📺 even though much of his career happened before he was BORN 👶 yet he still got to enjoy those endless RE-RUNS 🔄 that made his old man the respected and LOVED ❤️ actor we all remember!! James thanked the staff at Brinsworth House for their incredible LOVE 💕 kindness and CARE 🫂 while the Royal Variety Charity added that Richard would be SORELY 😔 missed by everyone there!! This absolute UNIT 🧱 started as a child ACTOR 🎥 in the 50s with uncredited roles then absolutely COOKED 🍳 in classics like Raiders of the River and even shared the stage with the Royal Shakespeare Theatre before sliding into that cheeky comedic VIBE 😏 that defined his whole CAREER 📈!!

From playing a defiant STUDENT 📚 in Spare the Rod alongside Max Bygraves to that wild cameo as Pharaoh Ptolemy XIII in the Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton CLEOPATRA 🐍 blockbuster the man was built DIFFERENT 🏗️ before fully committing to COMEDY 😂 in The Ronnie Barker Playhouse and The Galton and Simpson Comedy!! He even popped up in two films with Sir Cliff Richard including The Young Ones and Wonderful Life where his boyish CHARM 💋 had everyone simping HARD 🫦!! Then came the massive BREAKTHROUGH 💥 in 1973 when he starred as the ultimate flatmate Robin Tripp in Man About The House which ran for six series on ITV alongside absolute QUEENS 👑 Paula Wilcox Sally Thomsett Yootha Joyce and Brian Murphy in a storyline so spicy 🌶️ for the era that the two women had to pretend their male roommate was GAY 🏳️‍🌈 just to keep the landlords from FLIPPING OUT 😤!!

That daring plot about a man sharing a London FLAT 🛋️ with two unmarried women had the censors sweating BULLETS 💦 because everyone knew exactly what it IMPLIED 🍆 yet the show still SLAYED 🗡️ prime time thanks to Robin keeping up the pretence which created all the hilarious TENSION 😏 and made it acceptable for pre-watershed 70s audiences everywhere!! After that he went full dramatic HIGHWAYMAN 🐎 mode as the titular Dick Turpin from 1979 to 1982 before sliding back into sitcom HEAVEN ☁️ with Me and My Girl from 1984 to 1988 where he played a widow raising his adolescent daughter alongside Tim Brooke-Taylor Joanne Ridley and the legendary Joan Sanderson!! The man kept that effortless CHARM 😌 flowing through Trouble in Mind in 1991 about a married psychiatrist having a mid-life CRISIS 😵‍💫 before things quieted down with a cheeky appearance in Noel's House Party and a starring role in the 1996 golf comedy Holed 🎳!!

Richard O'Sullivan was the undisputed KING 👑 of 70s and 80s British comedy who left us with countless re-runs full of warmth WIT 🧠 and that signature comic TIMING that still hits different even today!! His son wrapped it up perfectly by calling him always kind-spirited good humoured a doting GRANDFATHER 👴 and a wonderful dad who will be missed DEARLY 💔 while the whole nation mourns the loss of this sitcom ICON 🏆 who basically invented the cheeky flatmate TROPE 🛏️ that had everyone giggling and blushing at the same time!! From child star to comedy LEGEND the journey was nothing short of ICONIC 🏅 and those re-runs will keep his effortless charm alive forever in our living rooms 📺!!
